# The article ends on the image the opening used

## Statement
The ending returns to the image or fact the opening used and leaves it meaning
something new, and the text stops on that line.

## Applies when
always

## Influences
- S-10 · `E-14.segments` — the last segment carries nothing else.

## Conflicts
None known.

## Source
A fixture client rule for the Knowledge Maintenance job: client rules stay in
the client folder (§1), and §5.2 has the job scan them with the register.

## Change log
- v1, 2025-05-01: created as a fixture record.
